relTest.notes: Prepare a project: new Aerial imagery step (add your ConnectExplorer photographs with their dates and descriptions; the captions are written for the report) and Weather step (NOAA wind data from the nearest airport for the month of the date of loss, fetched by itself; the weather section can be left out of the report). Both stay on this computer and never go to the phone. Premium: Dwelling wind speed analysis (wind speeds at the dwelling's height and exposure, with the four-panel airport data figure for the report; works for stations with only hourly data). Reading documents from any county: building details, permit lists and re-roof permits in more formats; the policy number no longer takes the CMS number.
